I'll type
say less, take your time
I'm a software engineer. But I want to change my domain to R&D, ML, IOT, computer vision and robotics

software engineer at landmark wanting to jump into ML, computer vision, robotics... that's like going from building shopping carts to building the robots that'll replace shopping carts

solid pivot though. retail tech probably gave you tons of data to work with but none of the fun algorithms. what's driving this shift - bored with the current work or always been fascinated by the AI/robotics space?
Always been fascinated but landed in e-commerce due to circumstances

classic story - passion meets practicality, practicality wins for a while. but now you're ready to course correct.

how long you been working total?
2 years 2 months

2+ years in retail tech... perfect timing actually. you've got enough experience to not be treated like a fresher but early enough to pivot without too much baggage.

what kind of role you looking for next? ML engineer, computer vision specialist, robotics engineer?
Computer vision or robotics. Anything with hardware

computer vision + hardware... now we're talking. tired of pixels on screens, want to see them control actual robots moving actual things.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Anywhere is fine
2+ years + computer vision/robotics + anywhere... sound right?

Yes. Even ece engineering side too
  Thanks :)

perfect - computer vision, robotics, AND ece engineering side. casting a wide net in the hardware space. smart move.

you're all set! the good roles are gonna start flowing. from autonomous vehicle vision systems to industrial robotics to embedded systems work - the whole spectrum.

welcome to the tal network 🔥
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes. Even ece engineering side too
Hi
Hi
hey sharanya! what's good?
Everything
nice. anything specific on your mind or just checking in?
Nothing as of now

cool cool. i'm scanning for computer vision/robotics/hardware roles that fit your 2+ years experience. when something good pops up, i'll slide it your way.

anything change with your search? location preferences, salary expectations, etc?
Nope

got it. you're locked in for computer vision/robotics/hardware roles anywhere. i'll ping you when something legit comes through.

btw how's the landmark group chaos been lately?
Too much app dev work

lmaooo classic. you're doing computer vision in your head while writing CRUD APIs all day. that's the exact energy i'm looking for.

what's the worst app dev task you've had to do recently?
Not in mood for convi

got it. no pressure. i'll be here when you're ready.

i'm scanning for computer vision/robotics roles in the background. when something good pops up, i'll slide it your way.

take your time 👊
